comment: The Ratio jack covers only part of the knob's span: 3.2 ratios per volt over 10V reaches 32, and the knob is snapped, so each 0.3125V step moves the ratio by one. The Fine knob is clamped to positive values while the ratio is at 1, Ratio.cpp:53-55, which keeps the ratio above zero.
